edges.reason: restrict modifier reads permissions[msg.sender][requiredPermission] to authorise the guarded function
msg.sender is the primary key consulted in the permissions mapping for every privileged call
grantPermission writes permissions[agent][requiredPermission] after checking the caller's PermissionGranter flag
revokePermission clears permissions[agent][requiredPermission] guarded only by a msg.sender permission check
burn reads and subtracts balances[msg.sender], so a caller can only destroy their own holdings
approve/increaseApproval/decreaseApproval index allowed by msg.sender
transfer moves tokens out of the caller's own balance
transfer delegates all balance mutation to the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom delegates to _transferFrom, which enforces allowance
_transfer checks, debits and credits balances entries
_transfer queries feeAccount.calculateTransferFee on every transfer
_transferFrom validates then decrements allowed[from][msg.sender]
_transferFrom performs the actual balance movement by calling _transfer
_transferFrom calls feeAccount.calculateTransferFee to derive the fee
_transferFrom requires balances[from] >= amount + fee before proceeding
issueTo mints to an arbitrary 'to' address and is only guarded by the MonetarySupervisor permission
issueTo increases totalSupply by the minted amount
burn subtracts the amount from balances[msg.sender]
burn decreases totalSupply by the burned amount
delegatedTransfer first validates signature and replay protection through the helper
delegatedTransfer then executes the signed transfer via _transfer
delegatedTransfer builds txHash from the packed signed parameters including nonce
delegatedTransferAndNotify validates the signed hash through the same helper
delegatedTransferAndNotify moves the tokens with _transfer before notifying the target
delegatedTransferAndNotify invokes transferNotification on an attacker-supplied TokenReceiver after the transfer
transferAndNotify performs the token transfer before the notification callback
transferAndNotify executes arbitrary code in the target contract via transferNotification
_checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee marks delegatedTxHashesUsed[txHash] to prevent replay
_checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee relies on ecrecover to authenticate the signed instruction
the address returned by ecrecover is stored in the recovered local and compared to the claimed signer
_checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee pays the executor fee with an internal _transfer to msg.sender
the executor fee is credited to msg.sender, i.e. the untrusted caller of delegatedTransfer
sign/execute/dryExecute gate execution on isSigner[msg.sender]
sign requires isSigner[msg.sender] before accepting a signature
sign mutates scripts[scriptAddress] state and signCount and records the signer
sign indexes the scripts mapping with the scriptAddress parameter
execute triggers _execute to run the approved script
execute reads scripts[scriptAddress].state and requires the Approved state
_execute performs a delegatecall to the script address, giving it full proxy storage access
_execute writes the terminal Done or Failed script state
the delegatecall return value decides which script state is persisted
dryExecute uses an inline assembly block to copy and revert with the delegatecall returndata
dryExecute reuses the same delegatecall execution routine as execute
addSigners sets isSigner entries and is only reachable through a self delegatecall from an approved script
addSigners iterates the signers array parameter to register each address
addSigners increments activeSignersCount, changing future quorum thresholds
removeSigners clears isSigner entries and is guarded by the address(this) check
removeSigners decrements activeSignersCount while forbidding removal of the last signer
withdraw calls transferWithNarrative on a caller-supplied token contract before paying out ETH
withdraw sends ETH to a caller-supplied address after the external token call
the native value transfer is sent to the 'to' parameter chosen by the caller
migrate sends the entire reserve ETH balance to a caller-supplied address
the reserve ETH transfer destination is the 'to' parameter
execute targets the hardcoded AUGMINT_RESERVES contract and drains its balance
execute requires address(this) to equal STABILITY_BOARD_PROXY, so it only works inside the proxy delegatecall
the script invokes AugmintReserves.migrate with the full reserve balance
